# wso2is_identity_verification_provider (Resource)

Manages an identity verification provider, such as Onfido. The server uses it to check users' identity documents. To import, use the provider's ID.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "wso2is_identity_verification_provider" "onfido" {
  name = "Onfido"
  type = "ONFIDO"
  properties = {
    base_url    = "https://api.eu.onfido.com/v3.6"
    workflow_id = "f0b8..."
  }
  secret_properties = {
    token         = var.onfido_token
    webhook_token = var.onfido_webhook_token
  }
  claim_mappings = {
    "http://wso2.org/claims/givenname" = "first_name"
    "http://wso2.org/claims/lastname"  = "last_name"
  }
}

variable "onfido_token" {
  type      = string
  sensitive = true
}

variable "onfido_webhook_token" {
  type      = string
  sensitive = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Provider name.
- `type` (String) Provider type, for example `ONFIDO` (the connector must be installed). Changing it replaces the provider.

### Optional

- `claim_mappings` (Map of String) Provider claim by local claim URI, for example `{ "http://wso2.org/claims/givenname" = "first_name" }`.
- `description` (String) Description.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the provider is enabled. The default is `true`.
- `image_url` (String) Logo URL. The server sets a default for known types.
- `properties` (Map of String) Configuration properties, for example `base_url` and `workflow_id` for Onfido.
- `secret_properties` (Map of String, Sensitive) Confidential configuration properties, for example `token` and `webhook_token` for Onfido.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Provider ID.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import wso2is_identity_verification_provider.onfido <provider_id>
```
